parameters.query:
UPDATE posts
SET
  status = '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.next_status }}',
  scheduled_at = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.next_status }}' = 'cancelled' THEN NULL
    ELSE scheduled_at
  END,
  error_message = NULLIF('{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.error_message }}', ''),
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = {{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  event_type,
  status,
  input_payload,
  output_payload
)
VALUES (
  'Review Post',
  '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.event_type }}',
  'success',
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'id', {{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.id }},
    'action', '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.action }}',
    'previous_status', '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.previous_status }}'
  ),
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'message', '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.message }}',
    'status', '{{ $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.next_status }}'
  )
);

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.message, status: $('Validate Transition').item.json.body.next_status } }}
